content: Render blueprint (render.yaml) for a Python FastAPI web service: type: web, name, runtime: python, plan: free, buildCommand (e.g. pip install -r requirements.txt), startCommand (uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT), healthCheckPath: /health, region (oregon default/ohio/virginia/frankfurt/singapore), envVars with sync:false for secrets prompted at setup, autoDeployTrigger replacing deprecated autoDeploy boolean.
